describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background, with a stocky, quadrupedal body entirely covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the back and limbs and lighter cream on the chest and belly. It has the overall shape of a bear with a large bear-like head, short rounded ears, a long muzzle with a black nose, four thick pillar-like legs ending in broad clawed paws, and a very short furry tail. Integrated into the fur are numerous glossy, hard, dark brown to black plates resembling beetle exoskeleton, including a large irregular shield over the shoulder and neck, elongated ridged wing-cover-like plates on the flank, smaller triangular and oval plates on the back and rump, and jointed plates encircling the leg joints and ankles, with a row of small dark oval openings along the lower side. A single large, glossy black, upward-curving horn with small side tines projects from the forehead.

describe.description: A large quadrupedal creature with the overall shape, fur, head and paws of a brown bear, shown in side profile walking to the right. Its body is covered in thick shaggy brown fur with a lighter cream underbelly and chest. Integrated into the fur are multiple glossy dark-brown to black beetle-like exoskeleton plates on the back, flanks, shoulders, throat, and around the leg joints and ankles. A single long, curved, glossy black beetle horn with side teeth rises from its forehead between its small rounded bear ears.
